# cycle_stack_build (Data Source)

Looks up a Cycle stack build by ID or by `about.version`. Exactly one of `id` or `version` must be set. Use this to reference an existing build without creating a new one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a stack build by ID.
data "cycle_stack_build" "by_id" {
  stack_id = cycle_stack.demo.id
  id       = "651efd54c53f7b6e2c5a9f21"
}

# Or by the version set on the build.
data "cycle_stack_build" "by_version" {
  stack_id = cycle_stack.demo.id
  version  = "1.2.3"
}

output "live_build_state" {
  value = data.cycle_stack_build.by_version.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `stack_id` (String) The ID of the stack this build belongs to.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The unique ID of the stack build. Exactly one of `id` or `version` must be set.
- `version` (String) The version string from the build's `about.version` field. Exactly one of `id` or `version` must be set. The lookup fails if multiple non-deleted builds share that version.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) The user-defined description of the build.
- `git_type` (String) The git ref type used for this build (`branch`, `tag`, or `commit`), if the build was created from git.
- `git_value` (String) The git branch, tag, or commit used for this build, if the build was created from git.
- `hub_id` (String) The ID of the hub this build belongs to.
- `state` (String) The current state of the build (for example `live`).
- `variables` (Map of String) Build-time variables supplied when the build was created.
